name: Farmer Carry
cue_short: Heavy loads at sides; tall posture, walk smooth.
cue_long: Pick up matching dumbbells or kettlebells. Pack shoulders, brace lightly, walk with short controlled steps. Dan John staple.

name: Suitcase Carry
cue_short: Load in one hand; do not lean; walk tall.
cue_long: Hold one dumbbell at the side. Resist side-bending. Switch hands each set. Excellent anti-lateral core training.

name: Front-Rack Carry
cue_short: Bells racked at shoulders; ribs down, walk.
cue_long: Clean kettlebells to front rack. Keep elbows up and trunk braced while walking. Challenges posture under anterior load.

name: Overhead Carry
cue_short: Lock out overhead; walk without leaning or flaring ribs.
cue_long: Press one kettlebell or dumbbell overhead and walk. Only if overhead position is pain-free and stable.

name: Plate Hug Carry
cue_short: Hug a plate to the chest; walk tall.
cue_long: Hold a bumper or plate against the chest with both arms. Brace and walk. Simple gym carry when handles are busy.

default_prescription.notes: Uses weight plate, listed under barbell equipment access.

name: Dead Bug
cue_short: Low back gently pressed down; opposite arm/leg reach without flaring ribs.
cue_long: Lie on back, arms up, knees bent 90. Exhale and reach opposite arm and leg while keeping lumbar quiet. McGill-friendly anti-extension.

name: Front Plank
cue_short: Elbows under shoulders; long body; squeeze glutes.
cue_long: Forearm plank. Push floor away, squeeze glutes, keep ribs and pelvis stacked. Prefer quality short holds over long sagging holds.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cue_short: From knees, roll out only as far as ribs stay down.
cue_long: Kneeling rollout with ab wheel or barbell. Brace hard, roll forward without lumbar extension, pull back. High demand anti-extension.

default_prescription.notes: Requires ab wheel or barbell + plates.

name: Side Plank
cue_short: Elbow under shoulder; hips up; body in one line.
cue_long: Side plank on forearm. Stack feet or stagger. Lift hips so body is straight. McGill Big 3 companion.

name: Suitcase Hold
cue_short: Hold load at side while standing tall; do not lean.
cue_long: Static version of suitcase carry. Great if space is limited. Switch sides each set.

name: Bird Dog
cue_short: Opposite arm and leg reach; hips level; pause.
cue_long: On all fours, reach opposite arm and leg without rotating hips. Pause, return, switch. McGill Big 3 staple.

name: Face Pull
cue_short: Pull to face height; externally rotate at the end.
cue_long: Rope at upper-chest/face height. Pull toward face, hands finish near ears with external rotation. Athlean-X corrective staple.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
cue_short: Both knees bent 90; switch sides with tall torso.
cue_long: Seated 90/90 position. Transition side to side with control. Hip mobility prep for squats and lunges.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue_short: Lunge, hand down, rotate open toward front leg.
cue_long: Long lunge with back knee soft or down. Hand inside front foot, rotate chest open. Dynamic mobility for hips and T-spine.

name: Cat-Cow
cue_short: On all fours; alternate rounding and arching slowly.
cue_long: Gentle spinal mobility. Move segment by segment with breath. Prep, not a strength exercise.

name: Open Book
cue_short: Side-lying; open top arm and follow with eyes/chest.
cue_long: Lie on side with knees bent. Rotate the top arm open to stretch the T-spine. Keep knees stacked.

name: McGill Curl-Up
cue_short: One knee bent; hands under low back; lift head/shoulders slightly.
cue_long: McGill Big 3 curl-up. Maintain natural lumbar curve with hands under low back. Tiny lift of head and shoulders; hold.

default_prescription.notes: 8-10s holds. Switch bent leg between sets.

name: Glute Bridge
cue_short: Drive through heels; squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down.
cue_long: Lie on back, knees bent. Push floor away to lift hips until shoulders-hips-knees align. Avoid overextending the low back.

name: Dowel Hip Hinge Drill
cue_short: Rod along spine stays in contact at head, mid-back, and sacrum.
cue_long: Hold a dowel or broomstick along the back. Push hips back while keeping three contact points. Soft knees. Pattern practice before loading.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Hips back, soft knees, dumbbells skim thighs; flat back.
cue_long: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides. Hinge until you feel hamstring load, then drive hips forward to stand. Neutral neck.

name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
cue_short: Stand inside trap bar; brace, push floor away, lock hips.
cue_long: High handles preferred for many lifters. Set neutral spine, brace, drive through mid-foot. Often more spine-friendly than conventional for general pop.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Bar stays close; hinge until hamstrings load, then stand.
cue_long: Start standing with bar at hips. Soft knees, push hips back, bar tracks close to legs. Stop before lumbar rounds.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cue_short: Bar over mid-foot; brace, push floor, finish with hips through.
cue_long: Feet roughly hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Grip, wedge tight, brace hard. Push the floor away and lock out without hyperextending.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
cue_short: Hinge to kettlebell between feet; stand tall without yanking.
cue_long: Bell between mid-feet. Hinge, grip handle, brace, stand by driving hips. Good teaching step before swings.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue_short: Hike pass, snap hips; float bell to chest height, not a squat.
cue_long: Athletic hinge. Hike the bell back, then explosively extend hips to float the bell. Arms stay loose; power from hips.

name: Dumbbell Swing
cue_short: Hold one DB by the bell end; same hip-snap pattern as KB swing.
cue_long: Use a single dumbbell held at one end if no kettlebell. Same hinge mechanics and bracing standards.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Hinge on one leg; hips square, soft knee, reach back with free leg.
cue_long: Stand on one leg, hinge while keeping hips level. Light touchdown of free foot allowed for beginners.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cue_short: Face away from stack; hinge and snap hips to standing.
cue_long: Rope attachment between legs from low pulley. Hinge with flat back, then drive hips to stand. Spine-friendly hinge load.

name: March in Place
cue_short: Tall posture; drive knees up with opposite arm swing.
cue_long: Simple gait prep. March with controlled posture and opposite arm/leg rhythm. Warm-up staple.

name: Bear Crawl
cue_short: Knees hover; opposite hand/foot step; hips low and level.
cue_long: On all fours with knees slightly off the floor. Crawl forward with opposite limbs. Keep hips from swaying high.

name: Sled Push
cue_short: Forward lean into handles; drive legs, short powerful steps.
cue_long: Load sled appropriately. Lean in, keep arms locked on handles, drive through the floor. Low joint stress conditioner.

name: Sled Drag (Backward or Forward)
cue_short: Strap on; walk or backward drag with steady posture.
cue_long: Attach strap to sled. Forward or backward walks. Backward often used for knee-friendly quad work.

name: A-Skip
cue_short: Skip with knee drive and quick ground contact.
cue_long: Rhythmic skip emphasizing knee lift and posture. Speed/movement-skill primer in EXOS-style sessions.

name: Box Jump
cue_short: Load, jump onto box, soft land, step down.
cue_long: Choose a conservative box height. Jump, land quietly with soft knees, stand tall, step down (do not rebound off).

name: Bodyweight Split Squat
cue_short: Long split stance; lower back knee toward floor, front shin mostly vertical.
cue_long: Stagger feet. Drop the back knee toward the floor while keeping torso tall. Push through front mid-foot to stand. Switch legs.

name: Reverse Lunge
cue_short: Step back, drop knee, return; often knee-friendlier than forward lunge.
cue_long: From standing, step back into a lunge, then drive through the front foot to return. Keep hips square.

name: Walking Lunge
cue_short: Step forward, descend, then next step; torso tall.
cue_long: Continuous forward lunges. Control the descent and avoid crashing the back knee. Use dumbbells when bodyweight is easy.

name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cue_short: Back foot on bench; most load on front leg.
cue_long: Place rear foot on a low bench. Descend until front thigh approaches parallel. Front foot far enough forward that knee tracks well. Boyle staple.

name: Dumbbell Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cue_short: Same RFESS pattern with dumbbells at sides.
cue_long: Add dumbbells once bodyweight RFESS is stable for clean sets. Keep torso relatively upright.

name: Step-Up
cue_short: Drive through whole front foot; stand tall without pushing off back toe hard.
cue_long: Box roughly mid-shin to knee height. Step up fully, then control the descent. Avoid using the trailing leg as a springboard.

name: Lateral Lunge
cue_short: Step sideways, sit into that hip, other leg straight.
cue_long: Wide step to the side, sit hips back into the working leg, then push back to center. Trains frontal-plane strength often missing in gym plans.

name: Inverted Row
cue_short: Body straight; pull chest to bar, squeeze shoulder blades.
cue_long: Hang under a bar or rings with heels on floor. Pull chest to the bar while keeping a rigid plank. Raise feet or lower bar to progress.

name: Band Row
cue_short: Pull elbows back; stop before shrugging up.
cue_long: Anchor band at mid-torso. Row handles to the ribs with a tall chest and quiet neck.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue_short: Hinge support hand on bench; row elbow to hip.
cue_long: One knee and hand on bench, flat back. Row dumbbell toward the hip pocket without twisting the torso.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue_short: Tall torso; pull to ribs, control the return.
cue_long: Sit tall, slight knee bend. Pull handle to lower ribs, squeeze scapulae, then lengthen arms without rounding hard.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cue_short: Hinge, brace, row bar to lower ribs without yanking.
cue_long: Soft knee hinge to ~45 degrees torso. Brace, row bar toward lower ribs, keep neck neutral. Avoid using momentum.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cue_short: Chest on incline bench; row without lower-back stress.
cue_long: Set bench ~30 degrees. Lie prone and row dumbbells with full scapular motion. Spine-friendly horizontal pull.

name: Machine Row
cue_short: Chest pad set so you can reach without rounding.
cue_long: Adjust chest pad and seat. Pull handles with control; avoid shrugging at the finish.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
cue_short: Pull band down to collarbone; elbows toward ribs.
cue_long: Anchor band high. Kneel or stand and pull handles down while keeping ribs stacked over pelvis.

name: Lat Pulldown
cue_short: Pull bar to upper chest; no leaning back hard.
cue_long: Sit tall, slight lean. Pull bar to upper chest with elbows driving down. Control the stretch at the top.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
cue_short: Full hang to chin over bar with help from band or machine.
cue_long: Use band or assist machine. Start from dead hang, pull until chin clears bar, lower with control.

name: Pull-Up
cue_short: Dead hang, pull chin over bar, no kip unless programmed.
cue_long: Overhand grip slightly outside shoulders. Brace, pull elbows down, finish with chin over bar, lower fully.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
cue_short: Same as pull-up with added load at waist or feet.
cue_long: Add weight via belt, vest, or dumbbell between feet. Keep the same strict standards as bodyweight pull-ups.

name: Chin-Up
cue_short: Underhand grip; pull chin over bar with control.
cue_long: Supinated grip often more accessible than pull-ups. Same full range and braced trunk standards.

name: Wall Push-Up
cue_short: Hands on wall, body straight, press away without shrugging.
cue_long: Stand facing a wall, hands at chest height. Keep a rigid plank line from head to heels as you bend and straighten the elbows. Glutes and abs lightly braced.

default_prescription.notes: Step feet back to increase difficulty.

name: Incline Push-Up
cue_short: Hands on bench or box; rigid torso, chest to edge.
cue_long: Place hands on a stable elevated surface. Lower chest toward the edge with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso. Drive through the palms to lock out.

name: Push-Up
cue_short: Plank body, chest to floor, no sagging hips.
cue_long: Hands under shoulders, body in one line. Lower until chest nearly touches the floor, then press up. Squeeze glutes to keep ribs down.

name: Decline Push-Up
cue_short: Feet elevated; keep hips level and press evenly.
cue_long: Feet on a low box, hands on floor. Maintain a straight line and full range without dumping into the low back.

name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up (High)
cue_short: Higher feet elevation; own the plank under more load.
cue_long: Same as decline push-up with a higher surface. Stop if shoulders shrug toward ears or hips sag.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue_short: Upper arms touch floor; press without flaring hard.
cue_long: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells. Lower until triceps gently touch the floor, pause, then press. Limits shoulder range safely.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue_short: Feet planted, soft arch, dumbbells travel over mid-chest.
cue_long: Lie on a bench, retract shoulder blades lightly. Lower dumbbells with control, then press to lockout without slamming plates together.

name: Barbell Bench Press
cue_short: Pull bar to chest, drive feet, press in a slight arc.
cue_long: Set shoulder blades, feet on floor. Unrack, lower bar to mid/lower chest, then press up and slightly back. Use a spotter when near failure.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue_short: Hands just inside shoulders; elbows track close.
cue_long: Narrower grip than standard bench. Emphasize triceps while keeping wrists stacked and shoulders stable.

name: Band Chest Press
cue_short: Band behind back or anchored; press without losing rib position.
cue_long: Anchor band at mid-chest height or wrap behind the back. Press forward while bracing the trunk. Great home option.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue_short: Seat so handles meet mid-chest; controlled tempo.
cue_long: Adjust seat height so handles align with mid-chest. Press without locking out violently; keep shoulder blades on the pad.

name: Pike Push-Up
cue_short: Hips high, head toward floor between hands, press up.
cue_long: From a pike position (hips elevated), bend elbows to lower the head toward the floor between the hands, then press back to the start.

name: Landmine Press
cue_short: Press on an arc; ribs down, no leaning back.
cue_long: Anchor a barbell in a landmine. Press the sleeve upward/forward on an arc. Friendlier than strict overhead when shoulders are limited.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_short: Brace hard; press up without leaning into lumbar extension.
cue_long: Dumbbells at shoulder height. Squeeze glutes, brace abs, press overhead until elbows lock without shrugging excessively.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_short: Back supported; press in a controlled vertical path.
cue_long: Seated with back support reduces cheating via legs/low back. Press dumbbells overhead with even elbows.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cue_short: Bar from shoulders to lockout; move head through at the top.
cue_long: Start with bar on front delts. Press up, move head slightly through as bar passes face, finish stacked over mid-foot.

name: Band Overhead Press
cue_short: Stand on band, press overhead without rib flare.
cue_long: Stand on the band, handles at shoulders. Press overhead while keeping pelvis tucked under slightly and abs braced.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue_short: Seat so handles start near shoulder height; press smoothly.
cue_long: Adjust seat so start position is around shoulder height. Avoid slamming into end stops.

name: Pallof Press
cue_short: Press handle straight out; resist being twisted.
cue_long: Stand sideways to a cable or band at chest height. Press arms straight out and hold without rotating. Boyle anti-rotation staple.

default_prescription.notes: Each side. Can hold 3-5s per rep.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
cue_short: Half-kneeling; press out and own the hip/rib stack.
cue_long: Inside knee down (or outside depending on coaching preference). Same Pallof press action with less ability to cheat via feet.

name: Cable Anti-Rotation Hold
cue_short: Arms locked out in front; hold without twisting.
cue_long: End position of a Pallof press held for time. Great endurance anti-rotation dose.

name: Cable Chop
cue_short: High to low chop across the body; hips and shoulders turn together.
cue_long: Cable high. Chop down and across while rotating through the trunk with control. Cook chop/lift family.

name: Cable Lift
cue_short: Low to high lift across the body with braced rotation.
cue_long: Cable low. Lift up and across diagonally. Pair with chops for full rotary pattern.

name: Med-Ball Rotational Throw
cue_short: Load the back hip, throw into wall hard, catch or reset.
cue_long: Side-on to a wall. Rotate and throw the med ball into the wall. Power expression after strength base exists.

name: Band Face Pull to External Rotation
cue_short: Pull to face, then rotate hands back; pause.
cue_long: Often used as corrective/shoulder health work. Pull band to face height, externally rotate, control return. Athlean-X style shoulder hygiene.

name: Sit-to-Stand
cue_short: Sit to box with control, stand without using hands if possible.
cue_long: Use a chair or box. Reach hips back, sit lightly, then stand. Raise box height to make easier.

name: Bodyweight Box Squat
cue_short: Sit back to box, brief touch, drive up; knees track over toes.
cue_long: Feet roughly shoulder-width. Hips back to the box, light touch without collapsing, then stand tall.

name: Goblet Squat
cue_short: Hold weight at chest; elbows inside knees at the bottom.
cue_long: Cup a dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest. Sit between the hips, keep chest tall, drive through mid-foot to stand. Excellent default squat.

name: Front Squat
cue_short: Bar on front delts; elbows high; sit between hips.
cue_long: Clean grip or cross-arm rack. Keep elbows up and torso upright. Descend to depth you own, then stand.

name: Back Squat
cue_short: Brace, sit down and back; knees track, finish tall.
cue_long: Bar on upper back. Brace hard, break at hips and knees together, keep mid-foot pressure, stand to full lockout.

name: Leg Press
cue_short: Feet mid-platform; control depth without rounding low back.
cue_long: Set feet roughly shoulder-width. Lower until thighs approach torso without lumbar peeling off the pad, then press.

name: Band Goblet-Style Squat
cue_short: Stand on band, hold handles at shoulders, squat.
cue_long: Feet on band, handles at shoulders like a goblet. Sit between hips and stand against band tension.
